articles.title: Soccer Fever Sweeps the U.S.: World Cup Shatters Viewership and Attendance Records
articles.summary: The USMNT's opener drew 25 million viewers—more than double the 2022 World Cup's first match. Stadiums are 99.7% full, and fan festivals have pulled in 5.5 million people. The World Cup is a massive hit.

articles.title: Florida Fights Drowning Risk for Autistic Kids with Specialized Swim Lessons
articles.summary: Autistic children are 160 times more likely to drown. Florida's new law funds swim lessons, and a YMCA program uses one-on-one instruction to teach water safety. Researchers say it works fast.

articles.title: Supreme Court to Decide Whether States Can Purge Voter Rolls Close to Elections
articles.summary: A 1993 law bans systematic voter purges within 90 days of a federal election. Republicans want to exempt noncitizen removals. The Supreme Court will hear an Arizona case that could narrow the protection.
